Preserve every prior version, build, and tag mapping; delete none. Preserve actor/helper, dependencies, schema, fixture, request and body-read behavior, parser, cleanup, and output semantics. b2R2Proposal.observations: At reader acquisition, attach fulfillment and rejection observers to reader.closed and handle the observer promise. Track the existing read index, in-flight state and current phase without changing the awaited read. Record signal creation/fire times, read/stream settlement, cleanup, extraction/result and dataset-write stages. One unref'ed nonthrowing post-abort snapshot per row is cancelled if that row finishes first. Capture exact Node and Undici versions in the existing run_start event.
b2R2Proposal.reservedMarkerPolicy: Reserve one slot each for signal_created, body_reader_acquired, body_read_entered, body_read_completed, abort_fired, reader_closed_settled, post_abort_snapshot, post_abort_inflight_read_settled, first post_abort_cancel_enter, first post_abort_cancel_settled, cleanup_enter, cleanup_settled, catch, fetch_result, row_write, and row_terminal. Deduplicate within each type; optional events cannot displace reserved slots. The remaining eight per-row slots take the first eight redirect/response/pre-abort-cancel transitions in occurrence order; suppress later optional lines. Continue numeric state/counters in memory and include current values in reserved events. No per-read/chunk lines or effect on underlying operations.
b2R2Proposal.redaction: Never log URLs, headers, response bodies, article text, tokens, raw errors or other secrets. No polling or chunk logging.
b2R2Proposal.interpretation: Pending read and stream mean no observed settlement and unknown cause. Settled stream with in-flight read is distinct from read settlement; a later releaseLock-related rejection is not proof of a stream abort error. Settled read without row output localizes only a later observed cancel/cleanup/catch/fetch-result/write/worker-join phase. Missing snapshot while a row is active leaves timer/event-loop behavior uncertain. Signal creation-to-abort time is supporting Q2 context, not the primary R2 question. A matching abort/body-read stall on another row is a separate-row recurrence; report it independently and do not claim q3-us-01's historical cause was reproduced. Instrumentation may perturb timing; non-reproduction does not prove a fix.
b2R2Proposal.stop: Stop after the one run. Failure or incomplete execution remains Inconclusive / Hold and authorizes no fix, retry, resource change, or new diagnostic. A normal 100-row completion permits independent review of every counted text against the existing 50/100 target. B3 is not automatically eligible.
